title: Tim Curry
description:
He turned a midnight movie into a 50-year party.

Frank-N-Furter. Pennywise. Wadsworth. Nigel Thornberry. Same voice. Zero repeats.

Tim Curry, 1946–2026. The villain era lasted five decades.
